name: tsplit-keys-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile keys_job.py prep.py test_keys_job.py && python -m unittest -v test_keys_job > /out/keys_tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/keys_tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python prep.py --work /work > /out/prep.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/prep.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python fix_ttthresh.py --dest /work/src --reqs /work/requirements.txt > /out/fix.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fix.txt; exit $rc
cd /work/src && python -m unittest -v test_ttthresh_core > /out/tests_ttthresh.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests_ttthresh.txt; exit $rc
cd /work/tsplit && python -m unittest -v test_tsplit_core > /out/tests_tsplit.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests_tsplit.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && sha256sum keys_job.py prep.py test_keys_job.py requirements.txt fix_ttthresh.py src/ttthresh_core.py src/ttthresh_job.py tsplit/tsplit_core.py tsplit/test_tsplit_core.py | tee /out/sha256.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python keys_job.py --src /work/src --tsplit /work/tsplit --data-dir /data --out /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^KEYS_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
